chunks: And among what was narrated by ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan, from his father, from Abī Jamīlah, from Layth al-Murādī, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man having intercourse with his wife while she was menstruating, by mistake. He said: There is nothing upon him, though he has disobeyed his Lord.

key_terms.لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ: there is no penalty or expiation upon him
key_terms.وُقُوعِ: sexual intercourse or coming upon one's wife

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man has intercourse with his menstruating wife by mistake?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling on a man who has intercourse with his wife during menstruation unintentionally. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that no expiatory liability is upon him, while still describing the act as disobedience to Allah.
